objective: Reproduce the historical fulltrack Q3 and per-segment slot0 Q3 results under one frozen stack, isolate q9-versus-q0 inference-token associations within each Q-trained checkpoint family, compare fulltrack and per-segment checkpoint-family associations at q9, q0, and NoQ, and test whether a non-fulltrack arm reaches aggregate PQ >= 6.9. Evaluation-only contrasts do not identify the causal effect of Q training or caption corpus.

environment_observed_for_plan.launch_requirement: Implementation must persist and bind a full sorted pip-freeze manifest, GPU model/driver/CUDA facts, all resolved model/tokenizer/config files, and hashes of every executable source before final approval can be consumed. Preflight sets HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1, TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE=1, HF_DATASETS_OFFLINE=1, verifies every symlink target remains inside its registered snapshot, and performs a network-disabled local-only model/scorer load before GPU generation.

implementation_after_approval.implementation_gate: Gate 1 creates a non-launchable candidate contract with launch_allowed=false. After all no-GPU tests and independent implementation/security reviews pass, the security-executor may materialize a distinct immutable unregistered final contract with launch_allowed=true and approval_required=true. That boolean is necessary but never sufficient: the final launcher/HARN also requires the exact unexpired Gate-2 capability. Gate 2 binds the already-final bytes; neither contract is edited after its hash is reviewed or approved.

gate_1_implementation_only.purpose: Authorize creation and no-GPU testing only of the owned_new_files plus the exact sealed_input_staging root/tree/copy receipt listed in this Plan. Reading and copying registered inputs is allowed; shared source mutation is forbidden.
gate_1_implementation_only.scope_enforcement: Every created/changed path must be an exact approved repository file or descriptor-contained beneath one approved new root. Any out-of-scope path fails before write; /mnt/HDD registered inputs are read-only copy sources only.

gate_2_exact_registration_and_launch.purpose: After implementation and independent review, separately authorize the exact contract, source, argv, environment, launcher, tests, security receipt, and one append-tail registration transaction.
gate_2_exact_registration_and_launch.invalid_disposition: atomic hold before queue mutation or GPU launch

authenticity.trusted_origin: The operator's explicit approval in the Codex operator-console task is captured with task ID and exact approved fingerprints; READY or review receipts alone confer no authority.
authenticity.reservation_rule: Reserve atomically under the controller lock before registration; crash reconciliation is allowed only for the same run_id, nonce, and exact hashes.
authenticity.acceptance_bypass: Reject GPU_SCHED_ACCEPT=off and every unregistered acceptance override.
authenticity.auth_root_choice_required_at_gate_2: Either verify an external detached signature against a separately pinned operator public key, or require the operator to explicitly accept that malicious same-UID/root mutation is residual AUTH_ROOT risk. Local HMAC protects integrity/restart evidence but is not claimed to authenticate against malicious same-UID code.

sealed_input_staging.root_requirements: new non-symlink directory, UID 1005, mode 0700, local ext4 filesystem; all parents checked with openat/O_NOFOLLOW
sealed_input_staging.hf_cache_layout: The sealed root contains a private Hugging Face hub layout whose google/flan-t5-large ref is fixed to revision 0613663d0d48ea86ba8cb3d7a44f0f65dc596a2a and whose snapshot files are non-symlink regular copies. No refs/main drift or network fallback is accepted. The scorer receives the sealed Audiobox snapshot directory directly with local_files_only.
sealed_input_staging.sealed_runtime_layout: A mode-0700 source/MeanAudio tree contains frozen eval.py, the transitive meanaudio Python/config sources, approved new B-matrix scripts, and a weights subdirectory with staged VAE, vocoder, CLAP, and empty-condition files under the exact relative basenames used by eval.py/FeaturesUtils. Scientific child cwd and script root are this sealed source tree, so imports and every ./weights access resolve only to staged bytes. A sorted path/size/SHA-256 source-tree manifest is bound by gate 2.
sealed_input_staging.file_requirements: new UID-1005-owned non-symlink regular files, mode 0400, one hard link, exact registered size and SHA-256
sealed_input_staging.descriptor_rule: Final approval binds staged path, size, hash, st_dev, st_ino, and copy receipt. HARN opens with O_RDONLY|O_NOFOLLOW under held directory descriptors, hashes those descriptors, passes the same descriptors to child processes, rechecks fstat/hash after use, and never reopens mutable source paths.
sealed_input_staging.source_mutation_rule: Original HDD/NVMe/cache sources are read only during copying and may drift after the copy without changing approved staged execution; no shared mount or source permission is modified.
sealed_input_staging.implementation_authority: Gate 1 may create these staged copies and receipt, but neither staged bytes nor Gate 1 authorize registration or launch.

resolved_command_contract.execution_rule: No shell=True, shell parsing, eval, user-derived fragments, inherited Python path, cwd import, or .pth injection. Absolute interpreter and executable files are opened O_NOFOLLOW, hashed, fstat-bound, and executed from approved descriptors where supported.
resolved_command_contract.resolution_rule: The executable contract stores the fully expanded argv array for every arm and phase; placeholders are forbidden in the final contract. Dry-run snapshots must compare equal as arrays, not shell strings.

freshness_and_completeness_gates: Before an arm starts, its arm directory must not exist; any pre-existing path is a hard hold, never a skip.
Generation must produce exactly the 5521 TSV IDs, no symlinks, no extra files, mono 16 kHz finite non-empty audio, and one SHA-256 per ID.
Scoring must produce exactly one finite CLAP/CE/CU/PC/PQ row per ID. Missing or skipped items are fatal; aggregate-only partial means are forbidden.
The report must bind contract, checkpoint, TSV, complete argv, code, environment, audio-hash manifest, per-item metrics, and their SHA-256 values.
Audio cleanup is sequential and allowed only after the arm report and matrix controller both accept all bound manifests; cleanup is exact-ID only and emits a durable manifest.
Resume never regenerates a partial directory in place. A partial arm is quarantined for operator review and a newly approved run identity is required.

Every path component for contract, input, state, result, manifest, lock, executable, and cleanup is opened relative to a held trusted directory descriptor with no-follow semantics; symlink, FIFO, device, wrong owner/mode, or extra hard link is fatal.
Arm is a strict B1-B6 enum. Frozen MusicCaps IDs must match the safe basename grammar ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$ and reject slash, dot-dot, absolute, duplicate, or injected names.

Cleanup uses the held arm-directory descriptor, a persisted exact 5521-name intent/progress journal, and unlinkat-equivalent exact basenames only. Recursive deletion, globs, resolved untrusted paths, checkpoints, sealed inputs, and historical artifacts are forbidden.

reproduction_gate.quantization: Parse finite values through Decimal(str(value)); quantize to Decimal('0.0001') with ROUND_HALF_UP. Binary float round() is forbidden.
reproduction_gate.source_validation: All source hashes, status=passed, exact five metric keys, finite values, and B1 audit/report field equality must validate before comparison; malformed, drifted, missing, or nonfinite source values produce reproduction_invalid.
reproduction_gate.pass_rule: For both B1 and B2, every fresh aggregate after registered Decimal quantization must equal the corresponding derived historical Decimal value.
reproduction_gate.fail_rule: A valid but unequal comparison produces historical_repeat_failed. Any incomplete/invalid input produces reproduction_invalid. Either outcome holds B3-B6. Do not infer stale historical audio; code, dependency, hardware, or nondeterminism drift remains possible.

contrast_classifier.invalid: Any input/report/ID/metric/CI is missing, nonfinite, or gate-invalid.
contrast_classifier.small_or_uncertain: Every other valid case, including equality at zero-CI boundaries, same-sign means below threshold, and CIs touching or crossing zero.

decision_table.decision: HOLD matrix as invalid; B3-B6 do not start.
HOLD matrix; report non-reproduction under the frozen current stack; do not diagnose historical stale-audio contamination.

decision_table.condition: B1-B4 and B2-B5 share positive_supported or share negative_supported
decision_table.decision: Record a directionally replicated q9-versus-q0 inference-token association across both Q-trained checkpoint families.

decision_table.condition: one contrast is positive_supported and the other negative_supported
decision_table.decision: Record heterogeneous/opposite Q-token associations; no general Q direction.

decision_table.condition: exactly one contrast is positive_supported or negative_supported and the other is small_or_uncertain

decision_table.decision: Record no practically supported q9-versus-q0 association.
Q inference conclusion invalid; other valid matrix conclusions remain separately reportable.

decision_table.condition: B1-B2, B4-B5, and B3-B6 are all positive_supported
decision_table.decision: Record a stable positive fulltrack checkpoint-family association across q9, q0, and NoQ.
Record a stable negative fulltrack checkpoint-family association across q9, q0, and NoQ.

decision_table.condition: at least one is positive_supported and at least one negative_supported
decision_table.decision: Record heterogeneous checkpoint-family associations; reject a stable family-wide direction.

decision_table.condition: no opposite supported signs, but at least one contrast is small_or_uncertain
decision_table.decision: Record mixed/insufficient family-wide evidence; report each contrast separately.

decision_table.condition: any of the three contrasts is invalid
decision_table.decision: Family-wide conclusion invalid; no stable-family claim.

decision_table.condition: B2 or B6 is valid and aggregate PQ >=6.9
decision_table.decision: Record canonical non-fulltrack PQ>=6.9 achieved and name every qualifying canonical arm.

decision_table.condition: neither B2 nor B6 qualifies, but valid B5 aggregate PQ >=6.9
decision_table.decision: Record secondary q0 non-fulltrack PQ>=6.9 only; canonical target remains unachieved.

decision_table.condition: B2, B5, and B6 are valid and all aggregate PQ <6.9
decision_table.decision: Keep target open; await canonical 024/025/026 results and select the next training proposal without queue reordering.

decision_table.condition: no valid arm qualifies and one or more of B2, B5, B6 is invalid
decision_table.decision: Target verdict is invalid/incomplete; never convert invalid to not-achieved.

decision_table.condition: stable positive or stable negative checkpoint-family association
decision_table.decision: Prepare, but do not auto-launch, a separately approved matched fresh-training replication with immutable row binding; evaluation-only evidence cannot establish Q-training or corpus causality.

decision_precedence.contrast_scope: Invalid required contrast takes precedence; otherwise exactly one classifier applies by construction.
non_fulltrack_target: otherwise all three valid and below threshold
decision_precedence.boundary_semantics: PQ equal to 6.9 qualifies. Practical-effect mean equal to +/- threshold qualifies only if the directional CI bound is strictly beyond zero. CI touching zero is small_or_uncertain.

resource_and_recovery.gpu_exclusivity: One arm at a time; fail closed on any unknown compute process or missing p2 resource ownership.
resource_and_recovery.storage_recheck: Before registration, before every arm generation, before scoring, and before any retained-artifact expansion; warning emits an event, hard floor holds before the write.

budgets.budget_exhaustion: atomic hold; no automatic retry or next-arm launch

progress_and_stall.scoring_progress_signal: strictly increasing persisted exact-ID metric-row count
progress_and_stall.polling: deterministic local checks only; unchanged healthy polls make no model calls

resource_and_recovery.retry_policy: No automatic scientific retry. Infrastructure failure produces an idempotent failure/hold event; operator-reviewed fresh run identity required for regeneration.
resource_and_recovery.recovery_notifications: Every previously notified recoverable disk, stall, GPU-idle, notification-delivery, or other operational incident has a stable incident fingerprint and exactly one linked recovery event after deterministic evidence proves clearance. Persist and deliver recovery before promotion or compute/storage expansion; restart reuses the same event keys and cannot duplicate incident or recovery delivery.

harn_document_bundle.contract: /home/kojiek/MeanAudio/docs/experiments/fulltrack_q3_pq_bmatrix_contract.json with immutable launch_allowed=true and approval_required=true before Gate-2 signing
harn_document_bundle.permissions: State and outbox roots must be new/non-symlink UID-1005 mode 0700 directories; contract copies, approvals, keys, ledger, preflight, queue state, and outbox records must be UID-1005 mode 0600 regular files. Insecure pre-existing objects hold.
harn_document_bundle.controller_lock: One unpredictable-name mode-0600 lock file opened O_NOFOLLOW beneath a held state-root descriptor; flock remains held across validation, registration/launch transition, outbox changes, and terminal handoff. A second controller holds.
harn_document_bundle.atomicity: Every state transition writes a unique same-directory O_EXCL mode-0600 temporary file, fsyncs file and directory, then descriptor-relative no-replace/replace commit; ledger head hash, generation number, boot ID, and controller identity must match before mutation.
harn_document_bundle.integrity_chain: Ledger and outbox records use domain-separated HMAC-SHA256 plus previous-record hash. This is restart/tamper evidence under the declared AUTH_ROOT boundary, not same-UID authentication.
harn_document_bundle.event_idempotency_key: run_id + phase_id + event_kind + SHA256(canonical gate/verdict/report evidence). Transport retry count and timestamps are excluded, so all retries reuse one stable event key. A phase admits at most one terminal verdict; conflicting terminal evidence is a chain-fork hold.
harn_document_bundle.notification_delivery: Persist pending event before send; send structured bounded fields only with allowed_mentions empty and no raw log tails; webhook secret path/value never enters argv, environment manifests, reports, ledger, outbox, or message content. Persist accepted response before promotion. Retry only failures known to occur before request acceptance at 30,60,120,240,480 seconds, maximum five attempts. A crash or transport ambiguity after possible acceptance becomes notification_delivery_ambiguous and holds for operator reconciliation unless an idempotent relay proves deduplication.
harn_document_bundle.terminal_transition: Persist terminal evidence, deliver terminal notification, release only owned resources, atomically update queue state, then select/launch the next eligible entry or persist and notify its exact hold reason.
harn_document_bundle.validation: All four documents must pass scripts/validate_experiment_harness_documents.py before gate-2 approval can be issued.

registration_transaction.lock: /home/kojiek/gpu_queue/p2/runtime/queue-mutation.lock opened O_NOFOLLOW and held exclusively across snapshot, collision checks, creation, ledger commit, and approval consumption
registration_transaction.commit: Persist prior order, new order, approval hash, entry hash, and exact position; create target as mode-0700 regular file through unique same-directory O_EXCL temporary file, fsync, atomic no-replace rename, re-read and hash through held descriptor, append one registration ledger event, then consume approval nonce.
registration_transaction.post_registration_hold: If any defect is found after registration but before launch, atomically move only this owned 027 entry to p2/held, persist exact hold evidence, deliver hold notification, and leave 024/025/026 and all unrelated entries unchanged.
registration_transaction.eligibility: 027 is ordering-eligible only when 026 is verified completed, failed, or interrupted and its terminal notification is delivered. Held, resource-wait, notification-pending, and delivery-ambiguous are nonterminal and keep 027 ineligible unless a separately authenticated operator queue reorder or terminal transition occurs. Predecessor failure or interruption does not reorder or delete 027.
registration_transaction.gpu_lease: No current p2 lease FD is inherited. Equivalent proof is required without modifying the live host: locate the exact gpu0.lock device/inode in /proc/locks; require one exclusive-flock holder whose UID, PID/start ticks, boot ID, cgroup/session, executable and argv hashes identify the registered hold_lock.py process watching the exact p2 host PID; bind p2 owner/running records and the 027 guest ancestry/run_id/entry hash; open and retain pidfds for the lock holder and p2 host; verify all facts before and during every GPU phase. Any disappearance, mismatch, duplicate holder, released-lock nonblocking acquisition, or ambiguity holds immediately. An integration change to lib_host.sh/hold_lock.py is outside Gate 1 and forbidden by this Plan.
registration_transaction.foreign_process_gate: Immediately before every arm, enumerate all GPU compute processes with zero memory threshold. Only the exact owned lease process tree is accepted. A separately gate-2-approved passive allowlist may name the Irodori TTS executable identity, UID, cgroup/session, maximum 2048 MiB, and measured zero GPU utilization for 60 seconds; absent that exact approval, even 1 MiB unowned usage holds. No foreign process is signaled or modified.
